column1: # Interaction steps for the SDIO image: sent by the host runner in order, with
# the expected response after each; the judge verifies the responses in the
# received stream. One command per line, CR-terminated by the sender.
# Read-only checks only, and deliberately no `exit`: an early exit would close
# the shell the round's operator may still want after these.
# Both steps are race-free by construction: `help` lists the command tables the
# image was built with, and `sdio status` answers in one fixed shape whether or
# not the card has been brought up yet (the case table and the shell run
